title: 第388章 熊霸天在哪第387章 神魂中的钉子
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
“熊霸天？”
李清雪问这句话时，朱有福已经把吃的全搬到了石室外。
两大盆烤肉，一坛灵蜜，还有一筐小金以前最喜欢啄的火属性灵果。
东西准备得很足，却没有人知道两只灵兽能不能吃下去。
林天在地上坐定，将心神沉入神魂空间。
过去两年，他一直能感应到小金与熊霸天的生命印记。
印记没有熄灭，也没有持续衰弱，因此他只把这种状态当成重伤后的沉睡。
每隔一段时间，他都会送入温养血脉的药力，却很少真正打开空间深处。
不是不想看，而是那片区域在两只灵兽被强行收回时自行封闭。
贸然撕开，会直接冲击它们受损的兽魂。
如今林天进入法相境，对神魂空间的掌控远胜从前，终于能够绕开封闭处的血脉屏障。
空间深处没有所谓的地脉，也没有外敌。
小金悬在半空，身体包在一层暗淡金光里。
它的羽毛比两年前更长，却缺少光泽，胸口有一道被水柱打出的凹陷。
金光不断修补骨骼，每次刚愈合一点，残留在伤口中的深蓝水力便会再次把它压裂。
熊霸天趴在下方。
它的体型缩回幼兽大小，四只爪子抱着脑袋，背上的星辰纹路时明时暗。
魔鲸王那一击不仅打伤肉身，还震散了它强行催动的血脉之力。
万兽返祖丹残留的药力被逼出来，反而让它进入一种半疗伤、半返祖的自封状态。
林天最先看见的，是小金与熊霸天之间仍连接着一条很细的血脉光线。

第192章，两只灵兽一起服下万兽返祖丹，药力并没有被完全炼化。
到了海神祭坛，它们又同时承受魔鲸王一击。
返祖药力、太阳真火、星辰龙熊血脉和深蓝水压纠缠在一起，才形成了这层自我封闭。
也就是说，它们沉睡既是重伤，也是身体为了保命作出的选择。
若在过去两年里强行叫醒，可能会直接打断返祖。
两只灵兽没有失踪。
它们从第245章那场战斗以后，就一直在林天身边，只是再也没有醒来。
林天看着它们，胸口有些发闷。
朱有福通过契约投影看见里面的情况，低声道：“咱们当时只顾着逃出海神遗迹。后来清雪又昏迷，天哥突破，中州追兵一拨接一拨……”
林天回想这两年，几次在生死关头动过召唤它们的念头。
神魂空间没有回应，他便当作两只灵兽伤势未愈。
后来战场越来越大，敌人从金丹、灵府变成法相，他也下意识觉得，两只尚未完全成长的灵兽即使醒来，也不该被再次拖上战场。
这个判断不算错。
错的是他只确认生死，没有继续查沉睡的根源。
伙伴不是放进神魂空间、需要时再取出的法宝。
两只灵兽不能说话，更需要契约者替它们记录伤势。
“不是理由。”
林天道。
content_en:
"Xiong Batian?"
When Li Qingxue asked this question, Zhu Youfu had already moved all the food outside the stone room.
Two large pots of barbecued meat, a jar of spiritual honey, and a basket of fire-attribute spiritual fruits that Xiao Jin used to love to peck.
There was plenty of food prepared, but no one knew whether the two spiritual beasts could eat it.
Lin Tian sat down on the ground and sank his mind into the soul space.
In the past two years, he has been able to sense the life marks of Xiao Jin and Xiong Batian.
The mark did not go out, nor did it continue to weaken, so he only regarded this state as a deep sleep after a serious injury.
Every once in a while, he would send in medicine that warms and nourishes the blood, but rarely really opens up the depths of the space.
It's not that I don't want to see it, but that area closed on its own when the two spirit beasts were forcibly taken back.
If they are torn open hastily, their damaged beast souls will be directly impacted.
Now that Lin Tian has entered the Dharma Realm, his control over the soul space is far better than before, and he can finally bypass the blood barrier in the closed area.
There are no so-called earth veins in the depths of space, and there are no external enemies.
Xiao Jin was hanging in the air, his body wrapped in a layer of dim golden light.
Its feathers were longer than two years ago, but lacked luster, and there was a dent on its chest made by the water jet.
The golden light continued to repair the bones, and every time they healed a little, the dark blue water remaining in the wound would crack it again.
Xiong Batian lay down below.
Its body shrank back to the size of a cub, with four paws holding its head, and the star patterns on its back were bright and dark.
The Demon Whale King's blow not only injured his physical body, but also dispersed the power of his bloodline that he forcibly stimulated.
The remaining medicinal power of the Ten Thousand Beasts Ancestral Pill was forced out, which instead caused it to enter a self-proclaimed state of half healing and half atavism.
The first thing Lin Tian saw was that there was still a very thin bloodline between Xiao Jin and Xiong Batian.
In Chapter 192, two spirit beasts took the Ten Thousand Beasts Ancestral Pill together, but the power of the medicine was not fully refined.
When they arrived at the Poseidon Altar, they simultaneously withstood a blow from the Demon Whale King.
The power of the atavistic medicine, the true fire of the sun, the blood of the stars, dragons and bears, and the deep blue water pressure were intertwined together to form this layer of self-enclosure.
In other words, their sleeping is not only a serious injury, but also a choice made by the body to save life.
A forced awakening in the past two years might directly interrupt the atavism.
The two spirit beasts were not missing.
They have been by Lin Tian's side since the battle in Chapter 245, but they never woke up again.
Lin Tian looked at them and felt a little tight in his chest.
Zhu Youfu saw the situation inside through the contract projection and whispered: "We were only focused on escaping from the Poseidon ruins. Later, Qingxue fell into coma again, Brother Tian broke through, and Zhongzhou's pursuers came one after another..."
Lin Tian recalled that in the past two years, he had thought of summoning them several times at critical moments of life and death.
There was no response from the Soul Space, so he assumed that the two spirit beasts were still injured.
Later, the battlefield became larger and larger, and the enemies changed from Jindan and Lingfu to Dharma. He also subconsciously felt that even if the two spiritual beasts that had not fully grown up should wake up, they should not be dragged onto the battlefield again.
This judgment is not wrong.
What was wrong was that he only confirmed life and death and did not continue to investigate the source of sleep.
A partner is not a magic weapon that can be put into the soul space and taken out when needed.
The two spirit beasts cannot speak, and they need a contractor to record their injuries.
"Not a reason."
Lin Tiandao.
